narrator.en: The questions people ask before they start.

a.en: It answers from your own pages and brochures, and checks each answer against them before sending. If your content does not cover a question, it says so and offers to pass the customer to you.

q.en: What if it does not know?

a.en: It tells the customer it does not have that information and shows how to reach you. It does not guess.
Yes. It replies in English, Hindi or Hinglish, in the language the customer used.

q.en: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?

a.en: For WhatsApp you connect your own WhatsApp Business number through Meta. The setup screen walks you through it.
Each plan shows its price, and the pricing page has a calculator. Replies that hand the customer to you are free.

q.en: Can I use my own AI key?

a.en: Where your plan allows it, yes. You pay your AI provider directly and we charge only the plan.
Yes. When the free allowance is used up, the assistant shows your contact details instead of answering, until the next month or until you add balance.

q.en: Can my customer reach a real person?

a.en: Always. They can ask for a person in any language and get your WhatsApp, phone or e-mail.

q.en: Can you set it up for me?

a.en: Yes, we offer set-up help. Write to us from the contact page.

tax_line_in.en: Prices exclude 18% GST. A GST invoice for every payment.

credit_box.en: One answer to one customer question uses a small amount from your balance on the standard model. Better models cost more per answer, and the dashboard shows the price before you switch. Replies that hand the customer to you are free. Unused plan credit resets every month.

q.en: Do I get a GST invoice?

a.en: Yes. Every payment comes with a GST invoice you can download from your dashboard.
Yes. You keep what you have paid for until the end of the period.

q.en: What happens when my balance runs out?

a.en: The assistant shows your contact details instead of answering. It never goes silent. Add balance and it answers again.

q.en: Can I use my own AI key?

a.en: Where your plan allows it, yes. You pay your AI provider directly.
On the servers of the company that runs this service. Ask us for the region before you sign up.
